sec07-card-sec07-F08.question_text: How should you position your vehicle, signal, and yield before making a left or right turn?
sec07-card-sec07-F08.teaching_text: Turning wide from a middle lane cuts directly across parallel traffic and catches crosswalk pedestrians off guard.

sec07-card-sec07-F09.question_text: Which type of turn signal is safest, when are hand signals allowed, and where are hand signals barred?
sec07-card-sec07-F09.teaching_text: Showing up to your behind-the-wheel test with broken blinkers ends the drive before it starts because hand signals will not count.

sec07-card-sec07-F10.question_text: What maneuver is strictly forbidden in a center left-turn lane, and what hazard must you watch for inside it?
sec07-card-sec07-F10.teaching_text: Drivers from both directions pull into that shared middle lane simultaneously, making high-speed passing a head-on trap.

sec07-card-sec07-R09.question_text: How are reserved center left-turn lanes normally labeled, and is every center turn lane signed or painted?
sec07-card-sec07-R09.teaching_text: Written exams test whether you still recognize a shared turn pocket by its striping even when overhead signs or arrows are absent.

sec07-card-sec07-F11.question_text: At which three roadway locations must you never make a U-turn, and how do you reverse direction on an interstate?
sec07-card-sec07-F11.teaching_text: Blind sightlines and freeway speeds give approaching traffic zero time to dodge a vehicle swinging sideways across lanes.

sec07-card-sec07-R10.question_text: When direct left turns are restricted at a J-turn or median turnaround junction, how do you turn left?
sec07-card-sec07-R10.teaching_text: Removing direct left turns across fast divided highways cuts out the most dangerous T-bone conflict points.

sec07-card-sec07-F12.question_text: Who has the right of way at an all-way stop when cars arrive separately, simultaneously, or when unsure?
sec07-card-sec07-F12.teaching_text: Hesitation and double-starts cause intersection fender-benders, so yielding to the right or waiving ego prevents collisions.
sec07-card-sec07-F12.must_match_memory_hook: First stopped, left yields, doubt yields

visual_sync.text_span: First stopped, left yields, doubt yields

sec07-card-sec07-F13.question_text: In what direction does roundabout traffic circulate, how do vehicles enter or exit, and who yields?
sec07-card-sec07-F13.teaching_text: Stopping inside the circle or forcing your way ahead of circulating cars triggers immediate chain-reaction crashes.

sec07-card-sec07-R01.question_text: How does a traffic circle differ from a modern roundabout in traffic direction and approach signs?
sec07-card-sec07-R01.teaching_text: Assuming every circular junction runs one way with yield entries can catch you off guard at older stop-controlled circles.

sec07-card-sec07-F14.question_text: How must cars treat large vehicles in a multi-lane roundabout, and which side-by-side truck yields?
sec07-card-sec07-F14.teaching_text: Long trailers sweep across adjacent curved lanes as they turn, crushing anyone squeezing alongside them.
sec07-card-sec07-F14.must_match_memory_hook: Give trucks room; right truck yields

visual_sync.text_span: Give trucks room; right truck yields

sec07-card-sec07-R11.question_text: When should you select your lane for a multi-lane roundabout, and may you switch lanes inside it?
sec07-card-sec07-R11.teaching_text: Curved geometry skews mirror angles inside the ring, making mid-circle lane swaps a classic sideswipe trigger.

sec07-card-sec07-R12.question_text: How should you react when the vehicle ahead signals a turn or decelerates as if turning?
sec07-card-sec07-R12.teaching_text: A turning driver may pause suddenly for hidden crosswalk walkers or oncoming traffic right in the mouth of the turn.

sec07-card-sec07-R13.question_text: What three things happen to steering, braking, and crash impact when you drive above the speed limit?
sec07-card-sec07-R13.teaching_text: Extra speed multiplies kinetic energy faster than you expect, shrinking curve grip while stretching out panic stops.
sec07-card-sec07-R13.must_match_memory_hook: Worse steering, longer stops, harder hits

visual_sync.text_span: Worse steering, longer stops, harder hits

sec07-card-sec07-F15.question_text: What are the maximum rural interstate speeds for passenger cars versus heavy trucks above twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-card-sec07-F15.teaching_text: Loaded rigs carry massive momentum, so Indiana sets a five-mile-per-hour lower cap unless signs post even less.

sec07-card-sec07-F16.question_text: Unless otherwise posted, what is the maximum speed on a rural state divided highway?
sec07-card-sec07-F16.teaching_text: Test takers often confuse divided state highways with rural interstates, which sit ten miles per hour higher.

sec07-card-sec07-F17.question_text: In urban areas of fifty thousand or more people, what default speed limit governs interstates, non-divided state roads, and county roads?
sec07-card-sec07-F17.teaching_text: Tighter ramp spacing and heavier merging traffic in metro corridors require lower speeds than open rural stretches.

sec07-card-sec07-F18.question_text: When no speed sign is posted, what limits usually apply on urban residential streets and in alleys?
sec07-card-sec07-F18.teaching_text: Parked cars, blind garage aprons, and kids darting out leave almost zero reaction distance on narrow local lanes.

sec07-card-sec07-F19.question_text: During what weekday hours or conditions do school speed limits typically apply, and when can local towns lower them?
sec07-card-sec07-F19.teaching_text: Flashing beacons or children walking near the curb trigger reduced limits even outside the usual weekday bell schedule.

sec07-card-sec07-R04.question_text: What speed caps apply to a school bus on local roads versus on interstates and state highways?
sec07-card-sec07-R04.teaching_text: Knowing why buses cruise slower on county roads helps drivers anticipate gentle slowdowns instead of tailgating.

sec07-card-sec07-F20.question_text: By at least how much does a work-site speed limit drop below normal, and when are those limits active?
sec07-card-sec07-F20.teaching_text: Workers stand feet from live traffic behind cones, and fixed work-zone signs stay enforceable even with empty lanes.
sec07-card-sec07-F20.must_match_memory_hook: At least ten lower; check signs

visual_sync.text_span: At least ten lower; check signs

sec07-card-sec07-R16.question_text: What five weather, road, vehicle, or driver factors make driving right at the posted limit extra hazardous?
sec07-card-sec07-R16.teaching_text: Posted numbers assume dry pavement, healthy tires, and an alert driver, so bad conditions demand slower speeds.

sec07-card-sec07-F21.question_text: How many seconds of following space should you keep in normal driving, and how do you time it?
sec07-card-sec07-F21.teaching_text: Time-based spacing scales automatically as speed climbs, giving your eyes and foot room to react.
sec07-card-sec07-F21.must_match_memory_hook: Two to three seconds, fixed mark

visual_sync.text_span: Two to three seconds, fixed mark

sec07-card-sec07-R14.question_text: Roughly how many feet do you travel each second at thirty-five, fifty-five, and seventy miles per hour?
sec07-card-sec07-R14.teaching_text: Glancing away for even one heartbeat at highway speed moves your bumper several car lengths downrange.

sec07-card-sec07-R15.question_text: Which five vehicle and roadway factors determine how quickly your vehicle can come to a stop?
sec07-card-sec07-R15.teaching_text: Downhill slopes, slick asphalt, or bald tread can double stopping distance even if your reflexes are instant.

sec07-card-sec07-F22.question_text: How do you recover from a skid when driving a car equipped with conventional non-ABS brakes?
sec07-card-sec07-F22.teaching_text: Slamming brakes or cranking the wheel too far locks the tires and whips the tail into a spin.
sec07-card-sec07-F22.must_match_memory_hook: Ease off gas, steer into slide

visual_sync.text_span: Ease off gas, steer into slide

sec07-card-sec07-F23.question_text: How should you brake and steer with anti-lock brakes, and what does pedal vibration tell you?
sec07-card-sec07-F23.teaching_text: Lifting off when the pedal chatters defeats the computer pulsing that keeps your front wheels steerable.

sec07-card-sec07-R03.question_text: Does front-wheel versus rear-wheel drive change your skid steps, or does something else decide the technique?
sec07-card-sec07-R03.teaching_text: Knowledge questions love baiting learners with drivetrain differences when only conventional versus anti-lock braking alters your footwork.

sec07-card-sec07-F24.question_text: What should you do if your tires drop off the edge of the pavement, and why avoid jerking the wheel?
sec07-card-sec07-F24.teaching_text: Yanking hard against a pavement lip slingshots the car sideways across lanes and triggers violent rollovers.

sec07-card-sec07-R17.question_text: Nearly what fraction of passenger-vehicle deaths come from rollovers, and what keeps them from happening?
sec07-card-sec07-R17.teaching_text: Underinflated or bald tires fold and lose grip in sudden swerves, turning a recoverable wobble into a flip.

sec07-card-sec07-R18.question_text: On which road types are rollovers more common, and what roadside features trip vehicles leaving rural pavement?
sec07-card-sec07-R18.teaching_text: Without median barriers, a drifting tire digs straight into soft dirt, steep slopes, or drainage trenches.

sec07-card-sec07-R19.question_text: Above what speed does fuel consumption climb steadily, and how much extra gas burns at seventy-five versus fifty-five?
sec07-card-sec07-R19.teaching_text: Aerodynamic drag builds rapidly on the highway, draining your tank much faster for only minutes saved.

sec07-card-sec07-R20.question_text: How does fuel use on several short cold-start errands compare with one combined trip of equal mileage?
sec07-card-sec07-R20.teaching_text: Cold engines run rich and inefficient for the first miles, so chaining errands saves gas and wear.

sec07-card-sec07-R21.question_text: Which roadway structures ice over before regular pavement, and how should you drive near snowplows?
sec07-card-sec07-R21.teaching_text: Frigid air chills elevated decks from both top and bottom while plows throw snow clouds with wide blades.

sec07-card-sec07-R22.question_text: What three vehicle habits protect you when driving in bitter winter cold?
sec07-card-sec07-R22.teaching_text: A topped-off tank keeps cabin heat running if blizzards stall traffic, and cleared lenses keep you visible.
sec07-card-sec07-R22.must_match_memory_hook: Warm engine, full tank, clean lights

visual_sync.text_span: Warm engine, full tank, clean lights

sec07-card-sec07-R23.question_text: How does speed affect hydroplaning, and how should you dry wet brakes after crossing puddles?
sec07-card-sec07-R23.teaching_text: Soaked rotors lose friction until light pedal taps heat and wipe water off the brake linings.

sec07-card-sec07-F29.question_text: What is the rule whenever water covers a road, and what must you do if your engine stalls in floodwater?
sec07-card-sec07-F29.teaching_text: Shallow moving currents can sweep a car off hidden washed-out pavement in seconds, so abandon a stalled vehicle immediately.

sec07-card-sec07-R24.question_text: Which roadway weather hazard causes the most deaths every year, and what signs must you never bypass?
sec07-card-sec07-R24.teaching_text: Barricades hide collapsed culverts and rushing water where drivers drown trying to shortcut home.

sec07-card-sec07-F27.question_text: Which headlight setting belongs in fog, and what should you do when fog cuts visibility near zero?
sec07-card-sec07-F27.teaching_text: High beams bounce glare straight back off water droplets, and stopping inside a travel lane invites rear-end hits.
sec07-card-sec07-F27.must_match_memory_hook: Low beams slow; pull far off

visual_sync.text_span: Low beams slow; pull far off

sec07-card-sec07-F28.question_text: When must your headlights be turned on, and at what distances must you switch from high beams to low beams?
sec07-card-sec07-F28.teaching_text: Blinding oncoming drivers or lighting up a lead car's mirrors steals their lane vision in the dark.

sec07-card-sec07-R02.question_text: How does the low-beam dimming distance for oncoming traffic compare with the distance when following behind someone?
sec07-card-sec07-R02.teaching_text: Exam choices swap those two numbers constantly, so pair the longer buffer with headlights coming straight at you.
sec07-card-sec07-R02.must_match_memory_hook: Five hundred facing, two hundred behind

visual_sync.text_span: Five hundred facing, two hundred behind

sec07-card-sec07-R25.question_text: Where should you aim your eyes at night when an oncoming vehicle's headlights glare toward you?
sec07-card-sec07-R25.teaching_text: Staring into bright beams bleaches your night vision for seconds while the white edge stripe guides your lane.

sec07-card-sec07-R26.question_text: Which age bracket faces the highest risk of drowsy driving, and what share of fatigue crashes do they cause?
sec07-card-sec07-R26.teaching_text: Packed school, work, and late-night schedules make young drivers far likelier to nod off behind the wheel.
sec07-card-sec07-R26.must_match_memory_hook: Ages sixteen to twenty-nine, sixty-four percent

visual_sync.text_span: Ages sixteen to twenty-nine, sixty-four percent

sec07-card-sec07-R27.question_text: What five warning signs tell you fatigue is making you unsafe to keep driving?
sec07-card-sec07-R27.teaching_text: By the time your tires buzz rumble strips or your speed wanders, microsleeps are already shutting down your eyes.
sec07-card-sec07-R27.must_match_memory_hook: Yawns, blank miles, missed exits, drifting

visual_sync.text_span: Yawns, blank miles, missed exits, drifting

sec07-card-sec07-F31.question_text: Under Indiana law, what are the only two legal ways to use a phone or telecom device while driving?
sec07-card-sec07-F31.teaching_text: Holding a phone to text, dial, or scroll pulls eyes and hands off the wheel and brings an instant ticket.

sec07-card-sec07-R28.question_text: How many seconds does reading or sending a text steal from watching the road, and how far is that at fifty-five?
sec07-card-sec07-R28.teaching_text: Driving a hundred yards blindfolded in live traffic leaves zero chance to spot stopped cars or crossing pedestrians.

sec07-card-sec07-R29.question_text: What share of Indiana traffic fatalities stem from dangerous driving, and which three behaviors define it?
sec07-card-sec07-R29.teaching_text: Treating yellow lights, speed signs, or traffic gaps like a competition fuels one out of three fatal crashes statewide.

sec07-card-sec07-F32.question_text: How many listed unsafe acts in one continuous driving episode constitute aggressive driving under Indiana law?
sec07-card-sec07-F32.teaching_text: Stacking moves like tailgating, horn blasting, and cutting off drivers upgrades ordinary infractions into statutory aggressive driving.

sec07-card-sec07-R30.question_text: Why must you adjust your braking and turning timing on gravel roads?
sec07-card-sec07-R30.teaching_text: Loose stones roll like marbles beneath tires, turning late braking or sharp steering into an instant slide.

sec07-card-sec07-R31.question_text: What four precautions must you take as you approach the top of a steep hill?
sec07-card-sec07-R31.teaching_text: Farm gear, wandering oncoming cars, or stopped traffic can sit hidden right beyond a blind rural crest.
sec07-card-sec07-R31.must_match_memory_hook: Slow, keep right, watch, never pass

visual_sync.text_span: Slow, keep right, watch, never pass

sec07-card-sec07-R32.question_text: Which headlights should you switch on when driving along dusty dirt roads, and why?
sec07-card-sec07-R32.teaching_text: Hanging dust plumes hide unlit cars from oncoming traffic while high beams reflect glare back into your eyes.

sec07-card-sec07-F33.question_text: How should you use an interstate acceleration lane, and who holds the legal duty to yield when merging?
sec07-card-sec07-F33.teaching_text: Mainline drivers should create gaps when able, yet forcing your car in without yielding causes high-speed sideswipes.

sec07-card-sec07-F34.question_text: What must you do if you pass your interstate exit, and which vehicles may ever cross a median crossover?
sec07-card-sec07-F34.teaching_text: Backing on a ramp or cutting across median turnarounds reserved for emergency and maintenance crews causes deadly freeway wrecks.

sec07-card-sec07-R33.question_text: Under what only conditions are you allowed to stop or park on an interstate shoulder?
sec07-card-sec07-R33.teaching_text: Drifting highway traffic strikes parked cars on shoulders fast, so never pull over just to check texts or maps.

sec07-card-sec07-R34.question_text: Which lanes must trucks use on a two-lane-each-way interstate versus one with three or more lanes?
sec07-card-sec07-R34.teaching_text: Keeping heavy rigs in right-side lanes preserves sightlines and passing flow on multi-lane freeways.
sec07-card-sec07-R34.must_match_memory_hook: Right lane two; right two three-plus

visual_sync.text_span: Right lane two; right two three-plus

sec09-card-sec09-F01.question_text: Which single driving error ranks as the most common factor across all Indiana collisions?
sec09-card-sec09-F01.teaching_text: Misjudging gaps at intersections, left turns, and merge ramps triggers more Indiana wrecks than speeding.

sec09-card-sec09-R05.question_text: Which two driver failures — alone or together — lie behind most traffic crashes?
sec09-card-sec09-R05.teaching_text: Taking eyes off traffic while ignoring signs or right-of-way rules stacks two hazards at once.

sec09-card-sec09-F02.question_text: What must you do immediately if you are involved in a collision — and how should you position your car?
sec09-card-sec09-F02.teaching_text: Halting right at or beside the scene fulfills your legal stop duty while sparing approaching lanes.

sec09-card-sec09-F03.question_text: When must you move a crashed car off the traveled highway — and which four severe conditions forbid moving it?
sec09-card-sec09-F03.teaching_text: Minor fender-benders belong on the shoulder, whereas hazmat spills, injuries, fatalities, or trapped riders stay put.

sec09-card-sec09-R02.question_text: Which four crash situations override Indiana's rule to move vehicles off the traveled roadway?
sec09-card-sec09-R02.teaching_text: Leaving severe crash scenes undisturbed protects injured occupants from spinal movement and preserves responder safety.

sec09-card-sec09-F04.question_text: While remaining at a crash scene, which three details must you give and what card must you show?
sec09-card-sec09-F04.teaching_text: Sharing identity and registration numbers while displaying your license prevents hit-and-run charges.

sec09-card-sec09-F05.question_text: When a collision hurts or kills someone, how must you assist victims and whom should you make sure is called?
sec09-card-sec09-F05.teaching_text: Following instructions from nine-one-one dispatchers, medics, or officers prevents well-meaning bystanders from worsening trauma.

sec09-card-sec09-F06.question_text: Walk through your four steps after bumping an unattended parked car, mailbox, or fence?
sec09-card-sec09-F06.teaching_text: Driving off when nobody answers a doorbell turns a minor scrape into a hit-and-run unless you call police.

sec09-card-sec09-F07.question_text: If the BMV requests insurance verification after a crash, what electronic filing must your insurer submit?
sec09-card-sec09-F07.teaching_text: Your insurance carrier — not your own glovebox card — transmits proof of state-minimum coverage to the BMV.

sec09-card-sec09-F08.question_text: What are your three physical ways to avoid an imminent crash — and when does speeding up make sense?
sec09-card-sec09-F08.teaching_text: Drivers fixate on slamming brakes, forgetting that brisk steering or a burst of gas clears cross-traffic traps.

sec09-card-sec09-F09.question_text: When a collision looks unavoidable, which direction should you steer — and how should you leave the pavement?
sec09-card-sec09-F09.teaching_text: Controlled steering onto grass beats locking your tires into an uncontrolled sideways skid.

sec09-card-sec09-F10.question_text: If hitting something is unavoidable, how should you choose between soft brush, same-way cars, fixed objects, and oncoming traffic?
sec09-card-sec09-F10.teaching_text: Shrubs absorb energy best, same-direction cars cushion relative speed, and anything beats combined head-on force.

sec09-card-sec09-R01.question_text: Rank hitting a same-direction vehicle, a stationary object, and a head-on vehicle — and how can a sideswipe help?
sec09-card-sec09-R01.teaching_text: Angling into a glancing sideswipe bleeds speed gradually instead of stopping your cabin dead.

sec09-card-sec09-F11.question_text: If your right tires drop onto a gravel shoulder, how should you slow down and re-enter the lane?
sec09-card-sec09-F11.teaching_text: Riding the shoulder calmly until speed drops keeps pavement-lip height differences from spinning your car.

sec09-card-sec09-R06.question_text: What happens if you yank the steering wheel sharply back onto pavement after drifting onto the shoulder?
sec09-card-sec09-R06.teaching_text: Catching the asphalt edge at highway speed slingshots the car across lanes into oncoming traffic.

sec09-card-sec09-F12.question_text: How long does a car plunging into deep water usually float — and how should you escape during that window?
sec09-card-sec09-F12.teaching_text: Acting immediately while the hull still bobs at the surface beats waiting until water covers the glass.

sec09-card-sec09-F13.question_text: For what two reasons must you NOT try pushing open a car door after plunging into water?
sec09-card-sec09-F13.teaching_text: Heavy water pins doors shut from outside, and cracking one open sinks the floating cabin rapidly.

sec09-card-sec09-F14.question_text: Put your belt, window, children, roof, nine-one-one call, and belongings in order when escaping a car in water?
sec09-card-sec09-F14.teaching_text: Unbuckling yourself first and rolling down glass before freeing kids ensures nobody gets trapped inside.

sec09-card-sec09-R07.question_text: Do electric power windows usually still roll down right after a car enters water?
sec09-card-sec09-R07.teaching_text: Hitting the window switch immediately takes advantage of remaining battery power before shorting.

sec09-card-sec09-R08.question_text: How should older children and rear passengers team up inside a car that has entered water?
sec09-card-sec09-R08.teaching_text: Pairing older kids with toddlers while moving calmly toward front windows speeds group evacuation.

sec09-card-sec09-R09.question_text: Why climb onto the roof of a floating car first — and when should you swim for shore?
sec09-card-sec09-R09.teaching_text: Cold currents exhaust swimmers quickly, so stay perched atop the roof unless the vehicle slips underwater.

sec09-card-sec09-F15.question_text: What three driving abilities does alcohol degrade — and which three main factors determine blood alcohol concentration?
sec09-card-sec09-F15.teaching_text: Drinking fast on a lighter frame spikes blood alcohol rapidly, dulling judgment, coordination, and reflexes.

sec09-card-sec09-F16.question_text: Because prescription, over-the-counter, and recreational drugs impair coordination, what two checks belong before driving?
sec09-card-sec09-F16.teaching_text: Allergy pills or cold syrups sold without prescriptions can hit reactions just as hard as alcohol.

sec09-card-sec09-F17.question_text: Which turn, lane, speed, braking, and night-headlight behaviors flag a possibly impaired driver ahead?
sec09-card-sec09-F17.teaching_text: Spotting center-line straddling, random stops, or unlit night cruising warns you to hang way back.

sec09-card-sec09-R10.question_text: What drifting, following-distance, turning, and turn-signal habits also point to an impaired driver?
sec09-card-sec09-R10.teaching_text: Drivers blinking left while jerking right or riding bumpers lack sober lane awareness.

sec09-card-sec09-F18.question_text: What two immediate steps come first during a roadside breakdown or emergency?
sec09-card-sec09-F18.teaching_text: Getting clear of live travel lanes with four-way flashers blinking alerts high-speed traffic early.

sec09-card-sec09-F19.question_text: How many feet behind your disabled vehicle should a red reflective triangle sit on straight roads versus hills or curves?
sec09-card-sec09-F19.teaching_text: Blind crests and bends need triple-length warning room — five hundred feet instead of two hundred.

sec09-card-sec09-F20.question_text: Through which side should you exit a disabled car on a highway shoulder — after checking what three hazards?
sec09-card-sec09-F20.teaching_text: Stepping out away from highway lanes after scanning traffic, obstacles, and steep ditches prevents roadside strikes.

sec09-card-sec09-R11.question_text: Are all of the Indiana manual's roadside emergency tips mandatory state statutes?
sec09-card-sec09-R11.teaching_text: Indiana written exam questions carefully separate recommended roadside breakdown advice from enforceable statutory traffic laws.

sec09-card-sec09-R12.question_text: Which three visibility items belong in your vehicle — and where specifically should the flashlight stay?
sec09-card-sec09-R12.teaching_text: Stashing fresh-battery flashlights within driver reach beats digging through a dark trunk beside traffic.

sec09-card-sec09-R13.question_text: Which three cold-weather items should you pack in winter in case you wait hours for a tow?
sec09-card-sec09-R13.teaching_text: Dead batteries or empty tanks chill cabins below freezing fast during Indiana winter storms.

sec09-card-sec09-F21.question_text: Walk through your wheel grip, gas pedal, and exact braking timing during a sudden tire blowout?
sec09-card-sec09-F21.teaching_text: Stomping brakes mid-blowout yanks the rim violently toward the shredded tire and spins the car.

sec09-card-sec09-F22.question_text: What two immediate steps can slow your car and rebuild hydraulic pressure if conventional brakes fail?
sec09-card-sec09-F22.teaching_text: Dropping gears adds engine drag while rapid hard pumping can restore enough line pressure to stop.

sec09-card-sec09-R04.question_text: Contrast what your right foot does with the brake pedal in a blowout versus conventional brake failure?
sec09-card-sec09-R04.teaching_text: Mixing these two emergencies up on test day flips the exact opposite pedal survival action.

sec09-card-sec09-F23.question_text: How must your hand work the parking-brake release during brake failure — and what follows once stopped?
sec09-card-sec09-F23.teaching_text: Keeping your thumb on the release lets you ease off instantly if rear tires lock into a skid.

sec09-card-sec09-F24.question_text: Why must you never turn the ignition to LOCK while rolling in a vehicle with a steering interlock?
sec09-card-sec09-F24.teaching_text: Engaging the column pin mid-motion freezes the steering shaft so you cannot steer off the highway.

sec09-card-sec09-R14.question_text: Should you try switching off your vehicle while it is still rolling during a highway emergency?
sec09-card-sec09-R14.teaching_text: Shutting the engine down at highway speed kills power steering and power-brake boost when needed most.

sec09-card-sec09-F25.question_text: Which five habits — covering keys, doors, spares, idling, and parking spots — cut vehicle theft?
sec09-card-sec09-F25.teaching_text: Unattended warm-up idling and hidden magnetic spare keys hand thieves an effortless joyride.

sec09-card-sec09-R15.question_text: How should you angle your front tires and set your brake when parking to deter vehicle theft?
sec09-card-sec09-R15.teaching_text: Cranking front wheels hard right with the parking brake locked makes unauthorized roll-away towing harder.

sec09-card-sec09-F26.question_text: How do you immediately show a police officer behind you that you see their emergency lights?
sec09-card-sec09-F26.teaching_text: Signaling right tells the officer right away that you are cooperating and looking to pull over.

sec09-card-sec09-R16.question_text: What two assumptions might an officer make if you fail to signal when being pulled over?
sec09-card-sec09-R16.teaching_text: Rolling onward without a blinker looks like evasion or intoxication from the patrol car behind you.

sec09-card-sec09-F27.question_text: Where must you pull over for police — which two spots are off-limits — and what if no safe shoulder exists?
sec09-card-sec09-F27.teaching_text: Stopping in center medians exposes officers to fast left-lane traffic; slow with flashers until a safe spot opens.

sec09-card-sec09-R17.question_text: Where should you aim to stop during a nighttime pull-over — and what cabin switch helps reassure the officer?
sec09-card-sec09-R17.teaching_text: Parking beneath streetlights or gas-station canopies with your interior dome lamp lit keeps everyone visible.

sec09-card-sec09-F28.question_text: Once stopped for an officer, what three rules govern staying seated, phone calls, and the radio?
sec09-card-sec09-F28.teaching_text: Jumping out unasked alarms approaching officers, while silencing phones and music keeps instructions crystal clear.

sec09-card-sec09-R18.question_text: If your car has tinted windows, what should you do right after stopping and before the officer walks up?
sec09-card-sec09-R18.teaching_text: Lowering dark glass upfront lets the officer see every occupant clearly as they approach.

sec09-card-sec09-F29.question_text: Where should driver and passenger hands rest during a stop — and how do you retrieve documents?
sec09-card-sec09-F29.teaching_text: Sudden unannounced lunges toward a dark glovebox look dangerous until you tell the officer first.

sec09-card-sec09-F30.question_text: Does signing a traffic ticket admit guilt — and where does contesting a ticket belong?
sec09-card-sec09-F30.teaching_text: Signing merely confirms you received the citation copy, saving legal arguments for the judge.

sec09-card-sec09-R19.question_text: What happens to driving privileges if a suspected drunk driver refuses breath, blood, urine, or performance tests?
sec09-card-sec09-R19.teaching_text: Indiana implied-consent rules suspend your license when you refuse chemical or field sobriety testing.

sec09-card-sec09-R20.question_text: What identification must officers provide on request — and which three channels handle misconduct reports?
sec09-card-sec09-R20.teaching_text: Asking politely for name and badge number lets you file formal review after the stop concludes.

sec09-card-sec09-R21.question_text: What must Indiana police legally record at every single traffic stop?
sec09-card-sec09-R21.teaching_text: Even warning stops without a ticket require officers to log the driver's name and address.

sec09-card-sec09-F31.question_text: Why can't your senses detect carbon monoxide — and under what three conditions does it sneak inside?
sec09-card-sec09-F31.teaching_text: Colorless, odorless, tasteless gas slips into cabins through rusty pipes or bumper-to-bumper tailpipe plumes.

sec09-card-sec09-F32.question_text: What is the garage rule for running engines — and how do you set fresh-air vents in traffic versus winter highways?
sec09-card-sec09-F32.teaching_text: Closed garages trap lethal exhaust fast, while highway airflow clears cabins once out of gridlock.

sec09-card-sec09-R03.question_text: Contrast when your cabin's fresh-air vent should stay closed versus opened against carbon monoxide?
sec09-card-sec09-R03.teaching_text: Shutting the intake blocks tailpipe fumes inches ahead in jams, whereas open highway vents flush stale air.

sec09-card-sec09-R22.question_text: Which four physical warning signs point to carbon monoxide poisoning inside a vehicle?
sec09-card-sec09-R22.teaching_text: Pull over into fresh air immediately if passengers complain of sudden headaches, dizziness, or light sensitivity.

sec09-card-sec09-R23.question_text: Where can a leaky exhaust pipe seep fumes — and what maintenance habit and sound clue guard against it?
sec09-card-sec09-R23.teaching_text: Rusted mufflers under rear floorboards seep fumes straight into back seats while rumbling louder than normal.

sec01-card-sec01-F01.question_text: Which three credential categories are issued by the Indiana Bureau of Motor Vehicles?
sec01-card-sec01-F01.teaching_text: Every Hoosier card fits inside one of those three buckets depending on whether you identify, practice, or drive solo.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.question_text: Which specific credentials sit inside Indiana's permit group versus its license group?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.teaching_text: Motorcycle and commercial learners group with driver permits, leaving standard driver cards and CDLs in the license tier.

sec01-card-sec01-F02.question_text: Which Indiana residents qualify to receive a state identification card free of charge?
sec01-card-sec01-F02.teaching_text: Indiana waives the ID fee so eligible voters turning eighteen by Election Day never face a cost barrier.

sec01-card-sec01-F03.question_text: What card orientation and two milestone dates appear on Indiana credentials issued under age twenty-one?
sec01-card-sec01-F03.teaching_text: Clerks and officers spot youth status instantly from the vertical orientation and both printed birthday milestones.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.question_text: What year did Indiana launch redesigned high-security credentials, and what happens to older cards?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.teaching_text: You do not need an early trip to swap an older layout because it stays good until printed expiration.

sec01-card-sec01-F04.question_text: What visual symbol on an Indiana credential shows Real ID compliance for federal identification?
sec01-card-sec01-F04.teaching_text: Checking the upper-right corner for that star confirms your card clears airport security and federal entrances.

sec01-card-sec01-F06.question_text: Why did Congress pass the Real ID Act of two thousand five for state credentials?
sec01-card-sec01-F06.teaching_text: Uniform security rules let compliant state cards board commercial airplanes and enter military or secure federal sites.

sec01-card-sec01-F07.question_text: Since what exact date has Indiana satisfied federal Real ID Act standards?
sec01-card-sec01-F07.teaching_text: Indiana adopted compliant standards back on New Year's Day twenty-ten, years ahead of many states.

sec01-card-sec01-F08.question_text: Which state licenses and ID cards will DHS and TSA accept at airport checkpoints and federal buildings?
sec01-card-sec01-F08.teaching_text: Showing a non-compliant state card alone at TSA checkpoints gets turned away without a passport backup.

sec01-card-sec01-F09.question_text: During which three transactions can you upgrade to Real ID, and what document formats qualify?
sec01-card-sec01-F09.teaching_text: Plain photocopies fail counter review, so bring original records or certified copies when upgrading your card.

sec01-card-sec01-F10.question_text: Which four proof categories must you bring to a BMV branch for a Real ID upgrade?
sec01-card-sec01-F10.teaching_text: Leaving behind even one of those four document categories stalls your branch upgrade visit.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.question_text: Where can applicants review the complete Real ID document list or call the BMV toll-free?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.teaching_text: Reviewing Appendix A, REALID.IN.gov, or calling the BMV helpline beforehand prevents forgotten-paperwork headaches.

sec01-card-sec01-F11.question_text: Who may get an Indiana credential, and what three ties demonstrate legal state residency?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.teaching_text: Keeping an exclusive Indiana home, registering to vote locally, or enrolling a dependent in Indiana school proves domicile.
sec01-card-sec01-F11.must_match_memory_hook: Sole home, voter roll, school-age kid

visual_sync.text_span: Sole home, voter roll, school-age kid

sec01-card-sec01-F12.question_text: Which four groups staying in Indiana are excluded from resident status for BMV credentials?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.teaching_text: Living on campus, serving on base, or working temporarily without making Indiana your permanent home keeps residency elsewhere.

sec01-card-sec01-F05.question_text: What happens before Indiana processes your application if you hold a card from another state or territory?
sec01-card-sec01-F05.teaching_text: Cards from other states, DC, Puerto Rico, or territories must be turned in before your Indiana credential moves forward.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.question_text: How many driver or ID credentials may an Indiana resident hold at once across all states?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.teaching_text: Keeping an old state ID alongside a new Hoosier license breaks the strict one-card-per-person rule.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.question_text: Within how many days of becoming an Indiana resident must a licensed newcomer get an Indiana license?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.teaching_text: Driving past day sixty on your former state's license after moving in violates Indiana residency law.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.question_text: How long must a new Indiana resident who never held another state's license hold a learner's permit?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.teaching_text: Moving to Indiana without prior state licensing puts you on the full hundred-eighty-day learner track.

sec01-card-sec01-R02.question_text: How do Indiana's sixty-day and hundred-eighty-day clocks split for new residents?
sec01-card-sec01-R02.teaching_text: Tests love swapping these two numbers, so pair sixty days with transfers and one-eighty with first-time permits.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.question_text: Which three alternative items let a new resident eighteen or older transfer a valid out-of-state license?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.teaching_text: If your out-of-state plastic wallet card was lost during the move, a driving record or verification letter works.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.question_text: Which two out-of-state license conditions trigger taking Indiana's knowledge exam upon transfer?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.teaching_text: Either a recently lapsed card under five years or less than a year of clean tenure triggers written testing.
sec01-card-sec01-F17.must_match_memory_hook: Expired under five, held under year

visual_sync.text_span: Expired under five, held under year

sec01-card-sec01-F18.question_text: Which exams are required if an applicant's out-of-state license expired more than five years ago?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.teaching_text: Letting an out-of-state license sit expired past five years adds a behind-the-wheel drive onto the written check.

sec01-card-sec01-R01.question_text: How does crossing the five-year expiration mark change transfer testing for an out-of-state license?
sec01-card-sec01-R01.teaching_text: Five years is the exact dividing line where a road skills evaluation joins the written knowledge exam.
sec01-card-sec01-R01.must_match_memory_hook: Under five written, over adds drive

visual_sync.text_span: Under five written, over adds drive

sec01-card-sec01-F19.question_text: What age, prior license tenure, and branch screenings apply to a transferring driver under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.teaching_text: Young transfers need over sixteen years plus one-eighty days of age, six months licensed, vision, and written checks.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.question_text: What age and license rules govern who can receive an Indiana identification card?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.teaching_text: Infants, teens, and seniors alike qualify for a state ID provided they hold no active driver's license.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.question_text: How can an Indiana ID cardholder qualify to ride a motor driven cycle?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.teaching_text: Passing the MDC written check at fifteen or older adds moped-class riding authority onto a state ID.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.question_text: How long do an Indiana ID card and MDC endorsement last, and what changes for temporary residents?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.teaching_text: Standard Hoosier IDs run six years, whereas lawful temporary status ties expiration to authorized stay end-dates.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.question_text: What documents and branch checks earn a learner's permit once an applicant reaches sixteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.teaching_text: Turning sixteen unlocks the direct permit route without driver-ed enrollment, using full proofs plus vision and knowledge checks.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.question_text: What minimum age, form, and three-week timing rule apply to getting a learner's permit before sixteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.teaching_text: Showing up more than three weeks before behind-the-wheel class starts makes your enrollment certificate too early.
sec01-card-sec01-F24.must_match_memory_hook: Fifteen, CDE form within three weeks

visual_sync.text_span: Fifteen, CDE form within three weeks

sec01-card-sec01-R03.question_text: What extra hurdles apply to a fifteen-year-old permit applicant compared with someone sixteen or older?
sec01-card-sec01-R03.teaching_text: Both groups pass vision and written exams with full proofs, while fifteen-year-olds must add behind-the-wheel enrollment.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.question_text: Can an online theoretical course completion certificate serve as proof of driver-education enrollment at the BMV?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.teaching_text: Teens get turned away when bringing only an online classroom printout without behind-the-wheel provider enrollment.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.question_text: What emergency-contact rule applies to a learner's permit applicant younger than eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.teaching_text: Naming a minor friend fails the application rule requiring an adult emergency contact at least eighteen.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.question_text: How long does an Indiana learner's permit stay valid, and what exception applies to temporary residents?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.teaching_text: Most learners get two full years from issue, unless authorized temporary stay ends earlier.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.question_text: How does the lifespan of an Indiana ID card or MDC endorsement compare with a learner's permit?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.teaching_text: Keep six-year identification credentials separate from the shorter two-year practice window on learner permits.

sec01-card-sec01-F31.question_text: When does renewing an expired Indiana learner's permit require retesting?
sec01-card-sec01-F31.teaching_text: Renewing inside six months skips retesting, whereas waiting past one hundred eighty days brings back the exam.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.question_text: After retaking the knowledge exam for a long-expired permit, does your earlier valid permit time still count?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.teaching_text: Even when a six-month lapse forces a written retake, valid days you already held still credit toward one-eighty.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.question_text: Before turning sixteen or finishing driver-ed, who may supervise a fifteen-year-old enrolled permit holder?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.teaching_text: Notice fifteen-year-olds start with a licensed instructor or rehab specialist up front until family practice unlocks.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.question_text: Which family members or spouses in the front seat may supervise a permit holder under eighteen?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.teaching_text: Watch Indiana's twenty-five-year-old floor for relatives—four years higher than many neighboring twenty-one states.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.question_text: Who may supervise practice driving once a learner's permit holder is eighteen or older?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.teaching_text: Turning eighteen drops the blood-or-marriage relative requirement so any validly licensed twenty-five-year-old qualifies.

sec01-card-sec01-R04.question_text: How does Indiana's minimum age for a supervising relative compare with a supervising spouse?
sec01-card-sec01-R04.teaching_text: Exams frequently test this four-year gap where licensed spouses qualify at twenty-one while relatives need twenty-five.

sec01-card-sec01-R05.question_text: Who may supervise driving practice for a minor permit holder under Department of Child Services care?
sec01-card-sec01-R05.teaching_text: DCS approval lets trusted foster or mentor drivers aged twenty-five-plus step in alongside qualifying relatives.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.question_text: If a minor permit holder is not enrolled in driver education, which professionals may still supervise up front?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.teaching_text: Skipping a full driver-ed course never bars booking private practice drives alongside either certified professional.

sec01-card-sec01-F32.question_text: Who takes a BMV vision screening, and what must glasses or contact-lens wearers do?
sec01-card-sec01-F32.teaching_text: Tell the clerk and keep your glasses or contacts on so your corrective restriction matches how you drive.

sec01-card-sec01-F33.question_text: What happens after failing a branch vision screen, even when you bring back a doctor's letter?
sec01-card-sec01-F33.teaching_text: A doctor's note does not automatically waive road or vision testing if Driver Ability orders deeper evaluation.

sec01-card-sec01-F34.question_text: What three sources feed Indiana's multiple-choice knowledge exam, and what signs must you understand?
sec01-card-sec01-F34.teaching_text: Expect questions blending traffic statutes, defensive habits, and regulatory, warning, and signal meanings.

sec01-card-sec01-F35.question_text: Which four applicant groups must pass Indiana's driver knowledge exam?
sec01-card-sec01-F35.teaching_text: New permits, expired out-of-state or foreign holders, teen transfers, and Hoosiers expired past one-eighty days all test.

sec01-card-sec01-F36.question_text: How many active points on your Indiana driving record trigger a mandatory knowledge exam at renewal?
sec01-card-sec01-F36.teaching_text: Racking up six or more active ticket points turns a routine license renewal into a written retest.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.question_text: When must returning active-duty military personnel or dependents take the knowledge exam to renew?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.teaching_text: Military families get a ninety-day grace window after returning before a long-expired license triggers written testing.

sec01-card-sec01-F37.question_text: How early before branch closing must you arrive for a knowledge exam, and when can you retry?
sec01-card-sec01-F37.teaching_text: Walking in twenty minutes before closing misses same-day testing, and failed attempts wait until the next business day.
sec01-card-sec01-F37.must_match_memory_hook: Thirty minutes early, retry next business

visual_sync.text_span: Thirty minutes early, retry next business

sec01-card-sec01-R11.question_text: Beyond standard passenger driving, which four specialty operations have BMV knowledge exams?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.teaching_text: Heavy trucks, motorcycles, mopeds, and passenger-for-hire credentials each test specialized safety rules.

sec01-card-sec01-F38.question_text: What course hours let a permit holder take the skills exam at a participating school, and how long does it count?
sec01-card-sec01-F38.teaching_text: Completing thirty classroom and six driving hours unlocks school skills testing that stays good until permit expiration.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.question_text: Does an Indiana learner's permit need restriction J for a driver training school to administer your skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.teaching_text: Participating schools can test any valid Indiana permit holder whether or not restriction J appears on it.

sec01-card-sec01-F39.question_text: What two driver-education situations force a student to take the skills exam at a BMV branch instead?
sec01-card-sec01-F39.teaching_text: Failing classroom or driving portions—or picking a non-testing school—sends your road evaluation back to a BMV branch.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.question_text: Which two newcomer groups must take their driving skills exam specifically with a BMV examiner?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.teaching_text: Under-eighteen transfers with six-to-twelve months licensed and anyone transferring an out-of-country license test directly with BMV staff.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.question_text: Which three expiry, restriction, or medical situations also require a BMV skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.teaching_text: Licenses expired past five years, testing restrictions, and medical complaints or board referrals all require BMV road checks.

sec01-card-sec01-F40.question_text: What booking window, vehicle rule, and BMV fee apply to scheduling a branch driving skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-F40.teaching_text: Book between forty-eight business hours and three weeks ahead, bring your own car, and pay zero BMV fee.
sec01-card-sec01-F40.must_match_memory_hook: Forty-eight hours to three weeks, free

visual_sync.text_span: Forty-eight hours to three weeks, free

sec01-card-sec01-F41.question_text: Who is allowed inside the vehicle with you during a BMV driving skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-F41.teaching_text: Parents, translators, and friends wait back at the branch while BMV personnel ride along.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.question_text: How are interior cabin cameras and factory backup cameras treated during the driving skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.teaching_text: Recording inside the cabin is barred throughout the drive, though glancing at your reverse camera stays fine.

sec01-card-sec01-F42.question_text: What five condition and paperwork standards must your vehicle meet before starting the skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-F42.teaching_text: Forgetting current registration proof in the glovebox cancels your road test before leaving the parking lot.

sec01-card-sec01-F43.question_text: Which equipment or registration defects can make an examiner reject your test vehicle?
sec01-card-sec01-F43.teaching_text: Bald tires, missing bumpers, cracked mirrors, stuck doors, or lapsed tags end your appointment on sight.
sec01-card-sec01-F43.must_match_memory_hook: Bad registration, tires, bumper, glass, doors

visual_sync.text_span: Bad registration, tires, bumper, glass, doors

sec01-card-sec01-F44.question_text: Does the BMV examiner coach you during the skills exam, and what happens right before driving?
sec01-card-sec01-F44.teaching_text: Expect a few required pre-drive checks followed by silent, standardized scoring with zero driving tips.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.question_text: Which seven core on-road behaviors does the examiner grade during the skills exam?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.teaching_text: Clean signaling, safe following cushions, steady speed when passed, defensive scanning, obeying directions, and crisp intersection stops build passing scores.
sec01-card-sec01-R15.must_match_memory_hook: Lanes, gaps, passes, speed, defense, stops

visual_sync.text_span: Lanes, gaps, passes, speed, defense, stops

sec04-card-sec04-F01.question_text: What symbol prints on the front of your Indiana credential when you register as an organ donor?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.teaching_text: Emergency hospital teams spot that small front-side heart immediately when seconds matter for transplant recovery.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: Once someone eighteen or older registers as an organ donor in Indiana, can relatives override that decision at death?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Indiana's Donor Choice Law makes an adult's first-person donor registration legally final and binding.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: What two stages of parent or guardian approval apply when someone under eighteen wants to be an organ donor?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Minors need adult permission both to add the heart at the branch and again if tragedy strikes.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: Contrast family authority at death for an adult organ donor versus a donor under eighteen?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Turning eighteen shifts an organ-donor registration from parent-dependent consent into a legally unbreakable decision.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: What military ID must an active-duty U.S. service member show at a BMV branch to add an active-duty indicator?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Presenting an unexpired Common Access Card during issuance or renewal prints active-duty status onto your card.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: Which discharge condition and Defense Department form let a veteran add an Indiana veteran indicator?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: Bringing your verifying discharge paperwork earns the veteran indicator so long as separation wasn't dishonorable.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: Which three documents must a deceased veteran's surviving spouse bring to add a veteran spouse indicator?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Linking military separation proof with marriage and death certificates confirms surviving-spouse eligibility cleanly.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: Match the active-duty, veteran, and veteran-spouse indicators to the exact paperwork backing each one?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Sorting active CAC cards from veteran discharge forms and surviving-spouse certificates prevents wasted branch trips.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.question_text: Above what engine horsepower must a watercraft operator generally carry a valid driver's license in Indiana?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.teaching_text: Notice it says MORE than ten horsepower — a ten-horsepower fishing motor stays right at the line.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: How can an unlicensed person aged fifteen or older legally run a boat over ten horsepower?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: Finishing an Indiana DNR-approved boater course only counts while your valid Indiana ID card is aboard.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: Can someone under fifteen ever operate a watercraft with an engine exceeding ten horsepower in Indiana?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Even a completed boater safety course cannot unlock boats above ten horsepower before age fifteen.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: Contrast Indiana's over-ten-horsepower boating rule for unlicensed teens fifteen-plus versus kids under fifteen?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: Turning fifteen opens the DNR-course-plus-ID pathway, whereas fourteen-year-olds stay off bigger boat helms.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: How does a suspended driver's license affect boating — and how do reckless or intoxicated boat violations hit your record?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Watercraft violations feed straight back onto your BMV driving record just like highway tickets.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: On Indiana boundary waters, when must Hoosiers carry an Indiana license versus out-of-state boaters?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: Out-of-state boaters need an Indiana license only after entering an Indiana embayment, river, or stream.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: Contrast the Indiana driver's license rule on boundary waters for Indiana residents against out-of-state residents?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: Shared border lakes give out-of-state residents leeway until they steer into Indiana's own bays or rivers.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.question_text: Which three groups of individuals or organizations qualify for an Indiana disability parking placard?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.teaching_text: Permanent or temporary mobility limits, Disabled Hoosier Veteran eligibility, and disability-service groups all qualify.

sec04-card-sec04-R14.question_text: What kind of company may apply for an organizational disability parking placard?
sec04-card-sec04-R14.teaching_text: Shuttle fleets and centers authorized by state or local government use organizational placards while transporting clients.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.question_text: Which practitioners can sign State Form forty-two thousand seventy for a placard — and how do you submit it?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.teaching_text: Physicians, chiropractors, podiatrists, PAs, APRNs, optometrists, or ophthalmologists certify the form for mail or branch drop-off.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.question_text: Which applicants never need a health care provider's signature to obtain a disability parking placard?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.teaching_text: Existing Disabled Hoosier Veteran plate status or eligibility already proves qualifying service-connected disability.

sec04-card-sec04-F15.question_text: What does an Indiana permanent disability placard cost — and what two certifications could ever end it?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.teaching_text: Permanent hangers stay valid indefinitely unless a clinician or Veteran Affairs certifies status changed.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.question_text: Does a temporary disability placard charge a fee — and which date ends it first?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.teaching_text: Even if a provider writes eighteen months, the placard still expires twelve months from issue.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: Contrast Indiana's permanent disability placard against its temporary placard on price and duration?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Remembering permanent costs zero while temporary charges a fee and caps at one year nails test comparisons.

sec04-card-sec04-F17.question_text: On what calendar date — or earlier operational change — does an organization's disability placard expire?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.teaching_text: Shutting down disability transport or facility programs voids the organization's placard immediately before year four.

sec04-card-sec04-F18.question_text: What penalty hits expired-placard use — and may a valid placard holder ever park on the diagonal stripes?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.teaching_text: Wheelchair lifts and ramps unfold into those diagonal access aisles, making striped zones off-limits to everyone.

sec04-card-sec04-F19.question_text: What temporary option helps an Indiana resident who loses a credential while temporarily living out of state?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.teaching_text: College students or seasonal workers away from home can bridge the gap with an interim credential.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.question_text: What detail stability unlocks myBMV.com renewal — and how often in a row may you renew online or at a kiosk?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.teaching_text: Alternating online or kiosk renewals with in-person visits keeps branch photos and vision checks current.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.question_text: At what exact age-plus-days mark does a probationary license expire — versus midnight when for other credentials?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.teaching_text: Giving young adults thirty grace days past twenty-one lets them renew into an adult license cleanly.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.question_text: How does a probationary license's expiration rule stand apart from standard Indiana licenses and IDs?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.teaching_text: Standard cards die at midnight on your birthday, whereas probationary cards add thirty days past twenty-one.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.question_text: When does your credential actually expire if your birthday lands on a Sunday or holiday when BMV branches are closed?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.teaching_text: Extending validity through midnight of the next open business day prevents unfair holiday expirations.

sec04-card-sec04-R15.question_text: Do credentials held by residents with temporary lawful status follow standard birthday expiration cycles?
sec04-card-sec04-R15.teaching_text: Credential end dates align with federal immigration authorization rather than standard multi-year birthday cycles.

sec04-card-sec04-F23.question_text: What universal charge hits anyone who renews an Indiana credential after its expiration date?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.teaching_text: Even one day past midnight on your expiration date tacks an administrative late fee onto renewal.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.question_text: What three requirements hit when renewing a license expired at least one hundred eighty days up to five years?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.teaching_text: Letting an expired license sit six months brings the written knowledge exam back alongside penalty and vision.

sec04-card-sec04-F25.question_text: What extra behind-the-wheel requirement joins the penalty, written test, and vision check once expired five years or more?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.teaching_text: Crossing the five-year lapse mark treats you like a road-test candidate all over again.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: Contrast renewing a license expired one hundred eighty days to five years against one expired five years or longer?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Both tiers charge the penalty plus written and vision checks, while five-plus years tacks on driving skills.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.question_text: How early may U.S. citizens and permanent residents renew a license or ID — versus temporary lawful residents?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.teaching_text: Citizens and green-card holders get two full years ahead, whereas temporary status caps at thirty days.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.question_text: How many days before expiration may you renew an Indiana learner's permit?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.teaching_text: Don't confuse a permit's tight thirty-day renewal window with a driver's license's twenty-four-month window.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: Group which Indiana credentials renew twenty-four months early versus which cap at thirty days early?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: Both learner's permits and temporary-resident credentials share the exact same thirty-day early-renewal ceiling.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.question_text: At age twenty-one or older, how many active points on your record force a written exam at renewal?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.teaching_text: Accumulating six active violation points sends adult drivers back to the testing screen before renewing.

sec04-card-sec04-R10.question_text: What driving-record threshold triggers a mandatory knowledge exam at renewal for drivers twenty-one and up?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.teaching_text: Five active points renews normally, while hitting point number six unlocks a mandatory written retest.

sec04-card-sec04-F29.question_text: For how many days does an Indiana license stay valid after a service member's out-of-state tour, deployment, or discharge ends?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.teaching_text: Returning troops get a full three-month buffer to visit a branch after deployment or separation.

sec04-card-sec04-F30.question_text: What discharge paperwork lets a returning veteran renew an expired license at a branch — and what bonus can they add?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.teaching_text: Bringing DoD discharge papers or long-form DD two-fourteen handles renewal and adds the veteran badge together.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.question_text: To which chapter and topic does the Indiana manual direct chauffeur and public-passenger chauffeur holders for renewal rules?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.teaching_text: Legacy chauffeur credentials follow Indiana's modern For-Hire Endorsement rules for renewals, changes, and replacements.

sec04-card-sec04-F31.question_text: What must you do with your Indiana credential after legally changing personal information — and where?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.teaching_text: Keeping legal identity details matched across state records requires an official credential amendment.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.question_text: Within how many days — and how — must you report a change of principal legal address and amend your credential?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.teaching_text: Residential moves cannot be finished online because staff verify new Appendix A residency proofs in person.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.question_text: Through which three channels can you update just your mailing address?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.teaching_text: Adding a P.O. box or temporary mail drop skips document review and works from home.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: Contrast how Indiana handles a principal home-address change versus a mailing-address change?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: Don't fall for thinking myBMV updates your legal residence — home moves require branch Appendix A papers.

sec04-card-sec04-F34.question_text: Walk through the agency order, waiting time, and deadline for amending your credential after a name change?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.teaching_text: Visiting a BMV branch before Social Security servers sync overnight stalls your name-change application.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.question_text: When your Indiana license, permit, or ID is unexpired, how and at what cost can you replace a Social Security card?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.teaching_text: An active Indiana credential lets Social Security verify your identity online without charging a dime.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.question_text: Under what condition can you replace a lost or stolen credential online or at a kiosk — and up to how many times?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.teaching_text: myBMV and kiosks ship duplicate cards rapidly when your name and home address match file records.

sec04-card-sec04-R11.question_text: What happens once you have already ordered ten online replacements for a credential?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.teaching_text: After ten remote duplicates, Indiana requires appearing at a BMV counter in person.

sec04-card-sec04-F36.question_text: If your card is lost AND something besides your mailing address changed, why can't you order online — and what must you do?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.teaching_text: Any name or residence change converts a simple duplicate order into an in-person thirty-day Appendix A amendment.

sec08-card-sec08-F01.question_text: What does a work-zone flashing arrow board tell you when its lights flash without pointing left or right?
sec08-card-sec08-F01.teaching_text: Unnecessary panic lane changes create sideswipes when the board is merely alerting you to stay alert ahead.
sec08-card-sec08-F01.must_match_memory_hook: No arrow means caution, hold lane

visual_sync.text_span: No arrow means caution, hold lane

sec08-card-sec08-F02.question_text: What must you do when a work-zone flagger extends an orange or red flag straight into your lane, and when may you move?
sec08-card-sec08-F02.teaching_text: Creeping past an extended flag puts your bumper into one-lane alternating traffic or active heavy equipment.
sec08-card-sec08-F02.must_match_memory_hook: Horizontal flag stops; wait for wave

visual_sync.text_span: Horizontal flag stops; wait for wave

sec08-card-sec08-F03.question_text: How must you respond to each side of a work-zone flagger's handheld sign paddle?
sec08-card-sec08-F03.teaching_text: Flaggers flip that paddle as trucks and crews cross live lanes just ahead of your hood.
sec08-card-sec08-F03.must_match_memory_hook: Stop on STOP, creep on SLOW

visual_sync.text_span: Stop on STOP, creep on SLOW

sec08-card-sec08-R06.question_text: What does zipper merging mean at a lane closure, and why do some work zones post signs for it?
sec08-card-sec08-R06.teaching_text: Using both open lanes smoothly up to the taper keeps queues shorter and cuts speed differences between lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-R07.question_text: Why is speeding into a work zone so risky, and how should you space your car inside one?
sec08-card-sec08-R07.teaching_text: Stopped queues appear behind cones in seconds, leaving tailgaters nowhere to swerve between concrete barriers and workers.

sec08-card-sec08-F04.question_text: Which three categories of vehicles must stop fifteen to fifty feet before railroad tracks, and where is that stop waived?
sec08-card-sec08-F04.teaching_text: Following drivers get rear-ended or rear-end buses when they forget these vehicles must halt even without flashing lights.

sec08-card-sec08-R08.question_text: At which two kinds of railroad crossings does the mandatory stop rule not apply?
sec08-card-sec08-R08.teaching_text: Stopping heavy buses unnecessarily on dead crossings creates rear-end hazards where trains can no longer run.
sec08-card-sec08-R08.must_match_memory_hook: Skip signed abandoned or removed rails

visual_sync.text_span: Skip signed abandoned or removed rails

sec08-card-sec08-F05.question_text: Which standard traffic sign does a standalone railroad crossbuck act like, and when must you stop at one?
sec08-card-sec08-F05.teaching_text: Passive crossings have no gates or bells, so your own eyes and ears are the only train warning.
sec08-card-sec08-F05.must_match_memory_hook: Solo crossbuck yields; train means stop

visual_sync.text_span: Solo crossbuck yields; train means stop

sec08-card-sec08-F06.question_text: What is required when a railroad crossbuck is mounted together with a stop sign?
sec08-card-sec08-F06.teaching_text: Rolling through a stop-controlled rail crossing hides fast trains behind trees, grain bins, or angled approaches.

sec08-card-sec08-F07.question_text: Once railroad bells, flashing lights, or gates activate, how long must you remain stopped?
sec08-card-sec08-F07.teaching_text: Pulling forward while lights still flash risks meeting a second train unless an officer or flagman directs you.
sec08-card-sec08-F07.must_match_memory_hook: Wait until off or waved through

visual_sync.text_span: Wait until off or waved through

sec08-card-sec08-F08.question_text: What does Indiana law say about weaving around a lowered crossing gate or racing an approaching train?
sec08-card-sec08-F08.teaching_text: Locomotives look slower than they travel and take over a mile to stop, making gate-dodging fatal.
sec08-card-sec08-F08.must_match_memory_hook: Never skirt gates or race trains

visual_sync.text_span: Never skirt gates or race trains

sec08-card-sec08-F09.question_text: What must you confirm before starting across railroad tracks, and what happens if your vehicle stalls on them?
sec08-card-sec08-F09.teaching_text: Queueing bumper-to-bumper across rails traps your car in the strike zone if the traffic light ahead stays red.

sec08-card-sec08-F10.question_text: About how many seconds do you have to clear a crossing once lights start flashing and gates begin lowering?
sec08-card-sec08-F10.teaching_text: Hesitating on the rails wastes precious seconds before a fast freight train reaches the intersection.

sec08-card-sec08-F11.question_text: If your car is stuck on the tracks and a train is approaching, how should everyone evacuate and whom do you call?
sec08-card-sec08-F11.teaching_text: Running away from the tracks angled toward the locomotive keeps flying wreckage from sweeping forward into you.

sec08-card-sec08-F12.question_text: When a vehicle gets stuck on railroad tracks with no train in sight, whom should you call first and second?
sec08-card-sec08-F12.teaching_text: Railroad dispatchers connected to the blue Emergency Notification sign can halt rail traffic along that line immediately.

sec08-card-sec08-R09.question_text: At a crossing with two or more tracks, what must you verify right after one train finishes passing?
sec08-card-sec08-R09.teaching_text: A departing caboose can completely screen a fast train coming down the adjacent rail from either direction.

sec08-card-sec08-R10.question_text: Within what distance of a railroad crossing are you barred from passing another vehicle?
sec08-card-sec08-R10.teaching_text: Pulling left near tracks blinds you to stopped vehicles, buses, or warning lights ahead.

sec08-card-sec08-R11.question_text: Where trains share the middle of a city street, how do traffic signals warn drivers of an approaching train?
sec08-card-sec08-R11.teaching_text: Treating four-way flashing red like a routine malfunction instead of an active train warning puts you onto live rails.

sec08-card-sec08-R12.question_text: What changes about approaching trains at gated crossings inside designated local quiet zones?
sec08-card-sec08-R12.teaching_text: Relying on hearing a whistle with music playing fails completely where neighborhoods restrict routine horn blasts.

sec08-card-sec08-R19.question_text: What trend makes following a school bus toward railroad tracks especially important to anticipate?
sec08-card-sec08-R19.teaching_text: Drivers watching for flashing red lights forget buses stop at tracks too, fueling a rise in rear-end crashes.

sec08-card-sec08-R13.question_text: Without a special oversize or overweight permit, what are Indiana's maximum vehicle width, height, and weight?
sec08-card-sec08-R13.teaching_text: Knowing legal semi dimensions shows why big rigs fill whole lanes and pack twenty times a car's mass.

sec08-card-sec08-F13.question_text: At fifty-five miles per hour, how does a passenger car's stopping distance compare with a loaded tractor-trailer's?
sec08-card-sec08-F13.teaching_text: Darting closely ahead of a heavy rig with hot brakes guarantees it cannot stop inside your car's gap.

sec08-card-sec08-F14.question_text: Where are the four blind-spot zones around a tractor-trailer, including the front and rear distances?
sec08-card-sec08-F14.teaching_text: Cruising inside any of those four pockets makes your car completely invisible when the trucker shifts lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-F15.question_text: When trailing behind a tractor-trailer, what rule tells you instantly whether the truck driver can spot your car?
sec08-card-sec08-F15.teaching_text: Tailgating tucked behind trailer doors blinds both you to hazards ahead and the trucker to your bumper.

sec08-card-sec08-F16.question_text: On which side and in what manner should you always pass a tractor-trailer?
sec08-card-sec08-F16.teaching_text: Right-side blind spots stretch longer and wider, and hanging beside trailer tires risks blowout debris or lane drifts.

sec08-card-sec08-R14.question_text: Why do tractor-trailer drivers often swing wide before making a tight corner?
sec08-card-sec08-R14.teaching_text: Squeezing between a turning trailer and the curb pins your car when those rear axles cut across the corner.

sec08-card-sec08-R15.question_text: When approaching your highway exit near a tractor-trailer, why should you drop behind rather than cut ahead?
sec08-card-sec08-R15.teaching_text: Slicing across a rig's nose and braking for the ramp steals the stopping room an eighty-thousand-pound truck needs.

sec08-card-sec08-R16.question_text: What visual illusion about large trucks causes many car-truck intersection collisions?
sec08-card-sec08-R16.teaching_text: Large objects appear to move slower than small ones, tricking drivers into turning left across fast-closing rigs.

sec08-card-sec08-F17.question_text: How must you respond to a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red, white, or blue lights, and what infraction applies?
sec08-card-sec08-F17.teaching_text: Roadside responders work inches from highway lanes, so Indiana punishes skipping a lane change or ten-under slowdown harshly.
sec08-card-sec08-F17.must_match_memory_hook: Change lanes or drop ten; Class-A

visual_sync.text_span: Change lanes or drop ten; Class-A

sec08-card-sec08-F18.question_text: Which five parked amber-light work vehicles get Move Over protection, and what infraction class applies?
sec08-card-sec08-F18.teaching_text: Tow, maintenance, utility, trash, and survey crews face live traffic too, earning the same ten-under slowdown rule.

sec08-card-sec08-F19.question_text: What does Indiana's Move Over rule require when passing a disabled car flashing its hazard lights, and what penalty applies?
sec08-card-sec08-F19.teaching_text: Stranded motorists changing tires on narrow shoulders need the exact same lane buffer or ten-under drop.
sec08-card-sec08-F19.must_match_memory_hook: Hazards get lane or ten-under; Class-B

visual_sync.text_span: Hazards get lane or ten-under; Class-B

sec08-card-sec08-R01.question_text: How does the infraction class differ between failing to move over for emergency red lights versus amber or hazard lights?
sec08-card-sec08-R01.teaching_text: Test questions pair light colors with penalty tiers, separating emergency responders from service trucks and stranded cars.

sec08-card-sec08-F20.question_text: What does a school bus communicate with flashing amber lights versus flashing red lights and its stop arm?
sec08-card-sec08-F20.teaching_text: Treating flashing yellow bus lights as an invitation to gun the throttle puts you beside kids stepping off.
sec08-card-sec08-F20.must_match_memory_hook: Amber warns slowing; red means stopped

visual_sync.text_span: Amber warns slowing; red means stopped

sec08-card-sec08-R02.question_text: At what stage of a stop do a school bus's amber lights flash compared with its red lights and arm?
sec08-card-sec08-R02.teaching_text: Recognizing the pre-stop amber phase gives you smooth braking space before the red lights lock down traffic.
sec08-card-sec08-R02.must_match_memory_hook: Amber before stopping, red once stopped

visual_sync.text_span: Amber before stopping, red once stopped

sec08-card-sec08-F21.question_text: When must opposite-direction traffic stop for a school bus with red lights and stop arm out, and when may it continue?
sec08-card-sec08-F21.teaching_text: Painted center turn lanes never excuse oncoming traffic because only a physical barrier or unimproved median separates oncoming lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-F22.question_text: What misdemeanor and escalating felony charges can result from ignoring an extended school-bus stop arm?
sec08-card-sec08-F22.teaching_text: Passing a stopped bus risks children's lives and jumps from a misdemeanor to severe felony territory when someone gets hurt or killed.

sec08-card-sec08-F23.question_text: How much lane width and how many seconds of following distance should you give a motorcycle or motor-driven cycle?
sec08-card-sec08-F23.teaching_text: Riders swerve inside their lane for potholes and downshift quickly without tapping brake lights first.

sec08-card-sec08-R17.question_text: Why should you wait to see a motorcycle actually lean into a turn before pulling out in front of it?
sec08-card-sec08-R17.teaching_text: Many motorcycles lack self-canceling turn signals, so a leftover blinker from three blocks ago can fool you.

sec08-card-sec08-F24.question_text: What two clearances are required before you may legally overtake a bicyclist?
sec08-card-sec08-F24.teaching_text: Mirror-close passes buffet light bikes with wind gusts, so wait behind until three feet and oncoming space open.

sec08-card-sec08-R18.question_text: How many riders may pedal side by side on a road, and must cyclists stay inside a marked bike lane?
sec08-card-sec08-R18.teaching_text: Cyclists legally take the travel lane to dodge glass, storm grates, or car doors even beside a bike stripe.

sec08-card-sec08-F25.question_text: How do you avoid cutting off a bicyclist when making a right turn or a left turn?
sec08-card-sec08-F25.teaching_text: Right-hook and left-cross collisions happen when drivers misjudge how briskly a bicycle closes toward an intersection.

sec08-card-sec08-R20.question_text: What may motorists never do inside a bike lane, and when is crossing one permitted?
sec08-card-sec08-R20.teaching_text: Staging in a bike lane before corners or parking inside it forces riders abruptly into faster car traffic.
sec08-card-sec08-R20.must_match_memory_hook: Keep out; cross turning or driveways

visual_sync.text_span: Keep out; cross turning or driveways

sec08-card-sec08-R21.question_text: After parallel parking, what must you check before swinging your car door open?
sec08-card-sec08-R21.teaching_text: Flinging a door into a rider's path leaves zero room to brake or swerve away from live traffic.

sec08-card-sec08-R22.question_text: What special users do green-painted pavement and red-painted pavement designate?
sec08-card-sec08-R22.teaching_text: Color-coded conflict zones alert drivers instantly to dedicated bicycle corridors versus bus and taxi lanes.
