sec08-card-sec08-R23.question_text: What is a sharrow marking, and what two purposes does it serve on a city street?
sec08-card-sec08-R23.teaching_text: Positioning cyclists outside the parked-car door zone reminds drivers to share the lane patiently.

sec08-card-sec08-F26.question_text: What legal rights and duties apply to someone riding a horse or driving a buggy on a public road?
sec08-card-sec08-F26.teaching_text: Passing calmly without revving engines or honking respects their roadway rights and prevents spooking animals into traffic.

sec08-card-sec08-F27.question_text: Who takes priority when a traffic officer contradicts a signal, and how do official funeral processions cross lights?
sec08-card-sec08-F27.teaching_text: Live police commands override automated lights at crash scenes, and breaking into a marked procession invites intersection crashes.

sec08-card-sec08-F28.question_text: Which direction should you turn your front tires when parking downhill, uphill with a curb, or without any curb?
sec08-card-sec08-F28.teaching_text: Angling tires properly lets the curb catch a rolling car or guides it off pavement where no curb exists.
sec08-card-sec08-F28.must_match_memory_hook: Up with curb away; else right

visual_sync.text_span: Up with curb away; else right

sec08-card-sec08-F29.question_text: How should you position your body to see behind you when backing, and what turnaround move is forbidden?
sec08-card-sec08-F29.teaching_text: Mirrors leave huge rear blind spots, and reversing into cross traffic at an intersection causes surprise T-bones.
sec08-card-sec08-F29.must_match_memory_hook: Turn right, look back; skip intersections

visual_sync.text_span: Turn right, look back; skip intersections

sec08-card-sec08-R24.question_text: What setup distance, backing angle, and wheel turn sequence put your car cleanly into a parallel parking spot?
sec08-card-sec08-R24.teaching_text: Matching rear bumpers two feet out sets the pivot point that tucks your nose clear of the lead bumper.

sec08-card-sec08-F30.question_text: How close to a fire hydrant is parking banned, along with six other everyday street spots?
sec08-card-sec08-F30.teaching_text: Blocking hydrants, crosswalks, sidewalks, driveways, fire lanes, or live lanes delays emergency crews and traps pedestrians.

sec08-card-sec08-R25.question_text: What four highway, structure, or permit-controlled places are also off-limits for parking?
sec08-card-sec08-R25.teaching_text: Narrow bridge decks and tunnels lack escape shoulders, while accessible stalls stay reserved for valid placards.

sec08-card-sec08-R26.question_text: Why is the diagonally striped zone next to an accessible parking stall painted, and may placard holders park on it?
sec08-card-sec08-R26.teaching_text: Even another valid disability placard blocks wheelchair lifts from unfolding when someone straddles those access stripes.

sec08-card-sec08-F31.question_text: To which pedestrians must motorists always yield, and what two mobility aids help you recognize them?
sec08-card-sec08-F31.teaching_text: Visually impaired walkers rely on predictable traffic stops rather than eye contact when stepping off a curb.
sec08-card-sec08-F31.must_match_memory_hook: White cane or guide dog yields

visual_sync.text_span: White cane or guide dog yields

sec08-card-sec08-R27.question_text: What effect on a crossing pedestrian makes a driver's turn improper?
sec08-card-sec08-R27.teaching_text: If someone on foot has to pause, slow down, or dodge your bumper, you cut off their legal right-of-way.

sec08-card-sec08-F32.question_text: Who must buckle up inside a moving vehicle in Indiana, and do air bags replace seat belts?
sec08-card-sec08-F32.teaching_text: Air bags deploy at explosive speed to work alongside belts, injuring unbelted riders thrown too close.

sec08-card-sec08-R28.question_text: Where should lap and shoulder straps rest on your body, and how far back from the wheel should you sit?
sec08-card-sec08-R28.teaching_text: Belts over strong pelvic and shoulder bones spread crash forces while twelve inches gives air bags room to inflate.

sec08-card-sec08-R29.question_text: By what percentages do front-seat belts boost crash survival and reduce serious injury risk?
sec08-card-sec08-R29.teaching_text: Staying strapped inside the steel cabin prevents ejection and dashboard strikes that turn survivable hits fatal.

sec08-card-sec08-R30.question_text: What proof must someone carry to be legally excused from wearing a seat belt for medical reasons?
sec08-card-sec08-R30.teaching_text: Verbal excuses fail during a traffic stop unless signed medical paperwork from a physician backs them up.

sec08-card-sec08-F33.question_text: Up to what age must Indiana passengers ride secured in a car seat or booster seat?
sec08-card-sec08-F33.teaching_text: Adult seat belts ride across a small child's stomach and neck until a booster lifts them to fit.

sec08-card-sec08-R31.question_text: In vehicles with a passenger-side air bag, under what age does the National Safety Council advise seating kids in back?
sec08-card-sec08-R31.teaching_text: Front air bags inflate at chest height for adults, striking smaller children squarely in the head or neck.

sec08-card-sec08-F34.question_text: Where must three warning lights or reflectors sit around a disabled passenger car at night on a divided highway?
sec08-card-sec08-F34.teaching_text: Spacing markers front, rear, and traffic-side outlines your stalled lane long before fast headlights reach your bumper.
sec08-card-sec08-F34.must_match_memory_hook: Hundred ahead, hundred back, ten side

visual_sync.text_span: Hundred ahead, hundred back, ten side

sec08-card-sec08-R03.question_text: Which three emergency warning kits satisfy the breakdown rule for a disabled truck, bus, or tractor-trailer?
sec08-card-sec08-R03.teaching_text: Commercial rigs carry strict heavy-duty visibility gear that differs from passenger-car lanterns or reflectors.
sec08-card-sec08-R03.must_match_memory_hook: Three triangles, six fuses, three flares

visual_sync.text_span: Three triangles, six fuses, three flares

sec08-card-sec08-R04.question_text: How is a disabled car marked in daylight, and how far out must markers move near a curve or hilltop?
sec08-card-sec08-R04.teaching_text: Blind curves and crests hide stalled cars until five hundred feet gives highway traffic time to brake.

sec08-card-sec08-R05.question_text: On a divided highway, how far out does a disabled truck place its warning device compared with a car?
sec08-card-sec08-R05.teaching_text: Doubling the rear warning distance alerts fast multi-lane traffic earlier to a wide rig blocking space.

sec08-card-sec08-R32.question_text: When cargo or a tailgate extends past four feet behind a vehicle, how must you mark it day and night?
sec08-card-sec08-R32.teaching_text: Unmarked lumber or pipes jutting past bumpers look invisible in depth perception until a trailing car hits them.
sec08-card-sec08-R32.must_match_memory_hook: Over four feet, flag or lamp

visual_sync.text_span: Over four feet, flag or lamp

sec08-card-sec08-R33.question_text: What lights should you activate whenever your vehicle breaks down, even after pulling clear onto the shoulder?
sec08-card-sec08-R33.teaching_text: Flashing four-ways stop drowsy drivers from accidentally following your taillights right onto the shoulder.

sec10-card-sec10-F01.question_text: Which four proof categories — and how many Indiana residency papers — must a first-time applicant bring in original or certified form?
sec10-card-sec10-F01.teaching_text: Showing up with photocopies or just one utility bill sends first-time applicants home empty-handed.

sec10-card-sec10-F02.question_text: What must someone renewing, amending, or replacing a current Indiana card bring to upgrade to a Real ID?
sec10-card-sec10-F02.teaching_text: Even longtime Indiana drivers must visit a branch with original or certified proofs once to earn the star.

sec10-card-sec10-F03.question_text: Which U.S. birth certificates prove identity at the BMV — and which keepsake hospital version gets rejected?
sec10-card-sec10-F03.teaching_text: Decorative footprints from hospital nurseries carry zero legal weight compared with raised-seal vital-records copies.

sec10-card-sec10-F04.question_text: Under what condition can a U.S. passport book or passport card prove your identity?
sec10-card-sec10-F04.teaching_text: Check the expiration date inside the cover before heading to the branch because expired passports fail check-in.

sec10-card-sec10-F05.question_text: What three items must accompany a foreign passport for it to prove identity at an Indiana branch?
sec10-card-sec10-F05.teaching_text: Missing either the valid U.S. visa stamp or the current approved arrival record blocks identity verification.

sec10-card-sec10-R04.question_text: What two conditions let a Permanent Resident Card or Employment Authorization Card prove identity?
sec10-card-sec10-R04.teaching_text: Both plastic DHS cards must still be within date and pass electronic lawful-status verification.

sec10-card-sec10-F06.question_text: For someone born outside the U.S., which requirement can a delayed birth certificate satisfy — and which can't it?
sec10-card-sec10-F06.teaching_text: Don't count on a delayed foreign-birth record to cover immigration status without a separate federal document.

sec10-card-sec10-R01.question_text: If an applicant born abroad brings a delayed birth certificate for identity, how do they handle lawful status?
sec10-card-sec10-R01.teaching_text: Pairing that delayed birth record with a separate federal immigration proof completes both checkboxes.

sec10-card-sec10-R05.question_text: What two official steps validate an amended birth certificate showing a changed legal name or birth date?
sec10-card-sec10-R05.teaching_text: Only certified amendments officially recorded with the birth state's vital statistics office pass branch review.

sec10-card-sec10-R06.question_text: Once a non-citizen earns a Real ID Indiana credential, how can that card help in later BMV visits?
sec10-card-sec10-R06.teaching_text: Holding an existing Real ID credential streamlines identity proof during future Indiana branch transactions.

sec10-card-sec10-F07.question_text: If your current legal name or birth date differs from your birth certificate, what linking proof must you bring?
sec10-card-sec10-F07.teaching_text: Every name jump between birth and today needs an unbroken paper trail of legal court or marriage records.

sec10-card-sec10-F08.question_text: For a U.S. citizen, how many documents are needed to cover both identity and lawful status?
sec10-card-sec10-F08.teaching_text: One certified U.S. birth certificate or unexpired U.S. passport checks off identity and lawful status together.

sec10-card-sec10-R07.question_text: What two conditions make a federal Notice of Action acceptable as proof of lawful status?
sec10-card-sec10-R07.teaching_text: A bare receipt letter isn't enough unless DHS verification clears and supporting agency status papers accompany it.

sec10-card-sec10-R08.question_text: When does proof of an asylum application count toward Indiana's lawful-status requirement?
sec10-card-sec10-R08.teaching_text: Electronic Department of Homeland Security verification confirms pending asylum paperwork for credential eligibility.

sec10-card-sec10-F09.question_text: Which four everyday tax or payroll documents — showing your name and full nine digits — prove your Social Security number?
sec10-card-sec10-F09.teaching_text: Check tax forms before leaving home because truncated forms showing only the last four digits fail.

sec10-card-sec10-F10.question_text: What must an applicant not authorized to work in the U.S. submit instead of a Social Security number?
sec10-card-sec10-F10.teaching_text: Showing federal non-work documentation — and an I-ninety-four when requested — satisfies the SSN slot legally.

sec10-card-sec10-F11.question_text: Who is the ONLY group allowed to list a P.O. box as their residential address on an Indiana credential?
sec10-card-sec10-F11.teaching_text: Everyone outside the Attorney General's survivor-protection program must list a physical street residence.

sec10-card-sec10-F12.question_text: Within how many days of applying must utility bills, medical bills, bank statements, or pay stubs be dated?
sec10-card-sec10-F12.teaching_text: Grabbing a three-month-old electric bill off the kitchen counter fails Indiana's strict sixty-day freshness rule.

sec10-card-sec10-F13.question_text: How recent must a homeowner's, renter's, or auto insurance policy be to prove Indiana residency?
sec10-card-sec10-F13.teaching_text: Annual and six-month insurance declarations get a full one-year window instead of the sixty-day bill cutoff.

sec10-card-sec10-R02.question_text: Contrast the acceptable date window for W-twos, tax bills, and benefits statements against insurance policies?
sec10-card-sec10-R02.teaching_text: Annual tax and W-two forms go by calendar year, whereas insurance policies count twelve months backward.

sec10-card-sec10-F14.question_text: Which civic registration card and student enrollment records count as Indiana residency documents?
sec10-card-sec10-F14.teaching_text: Teen permit applicants often pair an official high-school transcript or enrollment printout with a parent's address proof.

sec10-card-sec10-R09.question_text: What two addresses must appear on a U.S. Postal Service change-of-address confirmation to prove residency?
sec10-card-sec10-R09.teaching_text: Official USPS forwarding confirmations displaying both old and new street addresses bridge recent moves.

sec10-card-sec10-F15.question_text: Which four living situations allow filing an Indiana Residency Affidavit when you lack two address documents?
sec10-card-sec10-F15.teaching_text: Teens or adults staying with relatives, experiencing homelessness, incapacitated, or full-timing in RVs use this path.

sec10-card-sec10-F16.question_text: When you live with a relative or friend, what age and documents must your host bring to co-sign at the branch?
sec10-card-sec10-F16.teaching_text: Your host appears in person with their Indiana credential, identity proof, and two residency documents.

sec10-card-sec10-R03.question_text: Contrast who signs the Indiana Residency Affidavit for an incapacitated applicant versus a homeless applicant?
sec10-card-sec10-R03.teaching_text: Resident guardians eighteen-plus vouch for incapacitated applicants, while shelter or nonprofit reps sign for homeless Hoosiers.

sec02-card-sec02-F36.question_text: Which three school-discipline reports from a principal force the BMV to suspend a juvenile's driving privileges?

sec02-card-sec02-R15.question_text: Why is a postal forwarding order not enough after moving, and where can you update your BMV address?

sec02-card-sec02-R14.question_text: How do photo-exempt reasons differ between permits-or-licenses and ID cards, and does the BMV still snap a photo?

sec02-card-sec02-F42.question_text: Under what exceptions may an unrestricted driver handle texts or emails while driving?
sec02-card-sec02-F42.teaching_text: Typing or reading messages by hand is illegal statewide unless operated hands-free, by voice, or calling emergency help.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.question_text: How is Indiana's telecommunications ban stricter for probationary drivers than the general rule for all drivers?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.teaching_text: Unrestricted adults may use hands-free or voice features, whereas probationary holders get nine-one-one emergencies only.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.question_text: Which devices count as telecommunications devices, and which two radio or truck systems are excluded?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.teaching_text: Phones, pagers, and texting gadgets are covered, while licensed CB radios and heavy-truck comms over ten thousand pounds are exempt.
